exposure: Consumption of homemade fermented milk and dairy products (FMP) by mothers during pregnancy
cohort: The study included mothers of children under 3 years old, divided into two groups: those with children diagnosed with egg allergy and those with healthy children, matched for age and sex.
finding: Mothers of children with egg allergy consumed homemade fermented milk and dairy products less frequently, in smaller quantities, and with less variety during pregnancy compared to mothers of healthy children, suggesting a protective effect against egg allergy.
